description: A busy indication in CONT_WAIT loses the contention round: back to LBT_WAIT, with lbt_wait_dcd_ms once idle because the burst gave no EOT, and the next round makes a fresh jitter draw.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). The S_UNIDATA_REQUEST is priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0, U_PDU "hello"; it asks for no confirmation, so it produces no SIS output (A-0095), and it is data queued for transmission (K-0096). Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15 then 4 (prng.md 5): 45000 ms, then 12000 ms. The LBT wait after the lost round is held while busy and starts at the idle (K-0087, K-0089) with the value the LBT rules give (K-0120): the burst gave no EOT, so DCD produced the idle and rule 2 gives lbt_wait_dcd_ms. Since corpus 0.7.0 the DTS also keeps dts.ttd at the earliest TTD in its transmit queue: started when a request becomes the earliest, cancelled when the transmit queue empties (C-1050).
